meta.title: Primals Wiki — Satisfactory-Style Documentation for ecoPrimals

biomeOS.role: OS kernel, orchestrator — the HUB where everything starts
biomeOS.description: biomeOS is the core operating system primal. Like the HUB in Satisfactory, all other primals register with it. It handles auto-discovery via Neural API, capability registration, and graph bootstrap.
biomeOS.notes: 570 lines of auto-discovery. TCP/UDS probing, graph bootstrap, auto-announce.

songBird.role: Mesh transport, federation — extracts data from the network
songBird.description: songBird handles mesh transport and federation between gates. Like a Miner extracting ore from nodes, songBird extracts data from network sources and moves it through the organism.

bearDog.role: Crypto identity, BLAKE3, BTSP — generates trust (power)
bearDog.description: bearDog provides cryptographic identity using BLAKE3 hashing and BTSP (BearDog Trust Signing Protocol). Like a power generator, it produces the trust that powers all authenticated operations.
bearDog.notes: FNV-1a identity hashes used in spirochete protocol for gate identification

nestGate.role: Data gateway, MCP server — combines 2+ data sources
nestGate.description: nestGate is the data gateway and MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Like an Assembler combining two ingredients, nestGate joins data from different sources into structured outputs.
nestGate.notes: THIS is what squirrel MCP tools connect to. The gateway to all membrane data.

petalTongue.role: Content rendering, WASM — multi-input rendering engine
petalTongue.description: petalTongue renders content through WASM. Like a Manufacturer taking 4 inputs to produce complex items, petalTongue combines template + data + style + config into rendered output.

sweetGrass.role: Knowledge graph — combines knowledge from multiple sources
sweetGrass.description: sweetGrass maintains the knowledge graph. Like a Foundry combining two ores into alloy, sweetGrass merges knowledge from different domains into a unified graph.

rhizoCrypt.role: Encrypted storage — packages and encrypts data
rhizoCrypt.description: rhizoCrypt handles encrypted storage. Like the Packager converting fluids to solid packages, rhizoCrypt encrypts and packages data for secure storage and transport.

toadStool.role: Service discovery — finds and catalogs all services
toadStool.description: toadStool discovers services across the mesh. Like an Oil Extractor placed on a node, toadStool probes ports and endpoints to find what's running.

barraCuda.role: Stream compute — processes data streams in real-time
barraCuda.description: barraCuda handles real-time stream processing. Like a Refinery processing crude oil into multiple outputs, barraCuda takes raw data streams and refines them.

coralReef.role: Distributed compute — the conveyor system between primals
coralReef.description: coralReef provides distributed compute. Like Conveyor Belts connecting buildings, coralReef connects primals and transports work between gates.

loamSpine.description: loamSpine is the data spine. Like Storage Containers holding items, loamSpine stores all data in the organism — JSON, JSONL, binary blobs.

squirrel.role: Agent dispatch, MCP — the single-input workhorse
squirrel.description: squirrel is the agent dispatch and MCP interface. Like a Constructor taking one input and producing one output, squirrel takes a tool call and dispatches it.
squirrel.notes: This is the MCP server that Cursor connects to. 1.7MB binary, lightest primal.

skunkBat.role: Intrusion detection — the guard at the gate
skunkBat.description: skunkBat detects intrusions. Like the Space Elevator guarding progression, skunkBat guards the organism perimeter.

sourDough.role: Fermentation engine — raw data → refined insights
sourDough.description: sourDough is the fermentation engine. Like a Smelter converting raw ore to ingots, sourDough takes raw OSINT and ferments it into insights through ollama tissue models.

swarmVine.role: Epidemic gossip — fluid data transport between nodes
swarmVine.description: swarmVine uses epidemic gossip protocol. Like Pipelines carrying fluids between buildings, swarmVine carries gossip messages between gates.

bingoCube.description: bingoCube coordinates complex multi-gate operations. Like the Quantum Encoder being the ultimate production building, bingoCube handles the most complex coordination tasks.
bingoCube.notes: Used in spirochete protocol for gate identification. FNV-1a hashes for all 10 gates.

dromedary.role: Sovereign reverse proxy, TLS, ACME — connects EVERYTHING
dromedary.description: dromedary is the reverse proxy with TLS and ACME. Like Power Poles and Lines connecting the entire grid, dromedary connects all services to the outside world.
dromedary.notes: Serves primals.eco. The bridge between LAN and WAN.

power_grid.note: Like Satisfactory, if compute demand exceeds supply on any gate, it trips
